Golden Ridge Reserve.about: The reserve’s introductory missions. Each teaches one technique and hands over the gear to practise it, so they are worth doing first even if you have played elsewhere.

missions.name: Tutorial
missions.desc: To ease you in, you’ll be presented with some short explanations and instructions. These instructions will cover the controls and how to catch your first few fish!
objectives: Move to the Jetty
Equip Rod
How to Cast
Catch Your First Fish
Greet the Shopkeeper
Catch Another Fish
Drag and Tension
Greet the Warden
Take a mission from the Challenge Board

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Beginner Class 1
missions.desc: This class will cover float fishing, baits and hook depth. The lesson will continue when you reach the marked location.
objectives: Go to the Marked Location
Read the Instruction
Equip the Bloodworm Bait
Catch a Fish Using a Bloodworm
Read the Instruction
Hook Depth
Catch a Fish by Float Fishing

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Beginner Challenge 1
missions.desc: A short practice run after Beginner Class 1. Catch five fish using what you have learned about float fishing and baits, then report back to the challenge board.
objectives: Catch 5 Fish
Go to the Challenge Board

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Beginner Class 2
missions.desc: In this class we will talk about using more powerful tackle, and why it is important to consider your hook size.
objectives: Read the Instruction
Create a Float Fishing Rig Using the Maiden Rod, Tyro Reel, 2kg / 4.41lb Fluorocarbon Line and Cigar Float
Go to the Marked Location
Learn About Hook Sizes

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Beginner Challenge 2
missions.desc: A short practice run after Beginner Class 2. Catch five fish with your new rig, then report back to the challenge board.
objectives: Catch 5 Fish
Go to the Challenge Board

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Advanced Class
missions.desc: Welcome to the third class of Taylor’s Tackle Academy. In this class we will explain the basics of spin fishing, talk about lures and lure retrieval, and explain fish ranks.
objectives: Read the Instruction
Create a Spin Fishing Rig Using the Spinner Lure
Go to the Marked Location
Catch a Fish
Catch a Silver Rank Brook Trout

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Advanced Challenge
missions.desc: A test of what the Advanced Class covered. Land three Silver rank fish of any species, then report back to the challenge board.
objectives: Catch 3 Silver Rank Fish of Any Species
Go to the Challenge Board

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Expert Class
missions.desc: Welcome to the final class of Taylor’s Tackle Academy. The class dives deeper into spin fishing, explains day versus night fishing and covers how to use the handbook to find and catch fish. In addition, the class will talk about Trophy Tokens, Reputation and the Souvenir Shop.
objectives: Read the Instruction
Go to the Marked Location
Catch a Gold Rank Sauger
Learn to Locate Specific Fish
Enter the Souvenir Shop

missions.name: Taylor's Tackle Academy: Expert Challenge
missions.desc: The final test of Taylor’s Tackle Academy. Land any fish of Gold rank or better.
objectives: Catch any Fish of Gold Rank or Higher
Graduation

missions.name: Bottom Fishing Tutorial

objectives: Receive Equipment

missions.name: Tourist Attraction - Dinosaur Bones
missions.desc: Dinosaur bones can typically be found in tunnels and caves.
objectives: Locate and report Dinosaur Bones

missions.name: Tourist Attraction - Petrified Trees
missions.desc: Petrified trees are entombed by various volcanic materials and can be found on hillsides.
objectives: Locate and report Petrified Trees

missions.name: Tourist Attraction - Bigfoot Tracks
missions.desc: Bigfoot Tracks have often been sighted on high traffic areas and popular footpaths.
objectives: Locate and report Bigfoot Tracks

missions.name: Equipment - Weather Stations
missions.desc: Weather Stations contribute to hydrometeorological observation and can be found at high elevation.
objectives: Locate and report Weather Stations

missions.name: Equipment - Floating Weather Stations
missions.desc: Floating Weather Stations monitor deformation and can be found in large water bodies.
objectives: Locate and report Floating Weather Stations

missions.name: Equipment - GPS Stations
missions.desc: GPS Stations monitor deformation and can be found on plateaus with a good view of the sky.
objectives: Locate and report GPS Stations

missions.name: Invasive Plant - Oxeye Daisy
missions.desc: Oxeye Daisies are typically found by the side of the road.
objectives: Locate and report Oxeye Daisies

missions.name: Invasive Plant - Purple Loosetrife
missions.desc: Purple Loosestrife is highly invasive in riparian areas.
objectives: Locate and report Purple Loosetrife

missions.name: Invasive Plant - Water Hyacinth
missions.desc: Water Hyacinth grows best in still or slow-moving water.
objectives: Locate and report Water Hyacinth

missions.name: Invasive Plant - Orange Hawkweed
missions.desc: Orange Hawkweed is well-adapted to a hillside environment.
objectives: Locate and report Orange Hawkweed

missions.name: Invasive Plant - Yellow Toadflax
missions.desc: Yellow Toadflax typically grows at high elevations.
objectives: Locate and report Yellow Toadflax

missions.name: Invasive Plant - Houndstongue
missions.desc: Houndstongue can be found typically in forest clearings close to riparian areas
objectives: Locate and report Houndstongue

missions.name: Infested Tree - Engelmann Spruce
missions.desc: Engelmann Spruce Beetles can be found by characteristic red dust on the bark and at the base of trees. Look for trees with brown foliage by the banks of water bodies.
objectives: Locate and report Engelmann Spruce Beetle Infestations

missions.name: Diseased Tree - White Pine
missions.desc: Blister Rust Disease grows at high elevation. Look for yellow globules of resin on tree bark and brown foliage.
objectives: Locate and report White Pine Blister Rust Diseases

missions.name: Infested Tree - Douglas-Fir
missions.desc: Douglas-Fir Beetle Infestations grow in river drainage areas. Look for trees with brown foliage and orange larvae consuming the outer tree bark.
objectives: Locate and report Douglas-Fir Beetle Infestations
